Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Probably borrowed from Latin ēligere.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [ə.ləˈʒi]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [e.leˈd͡ʒiɾ]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Verb

[edit]

elegir (first-person singular present elegeixo, first-person singular preterite elegí, past participle elegit)

  1. to choose, elect
    Synonym: escollir

Spanish

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • eligir (obsolete)
  • esleer (archaic)
  • esleír (archaic)

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin ēligere. Compare the inherited doublet esleír.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /eleˈxiɾ/ [e.leˈxiɾ]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -iɾ
  • Syllabification: e‧le‧gir

Verb

[edit]

elegir (first-person singular present elijo, first-person singular preterite elegí, past participle elegido or electo)

  1. (transitive) to choose
    Synonyms: escoger, seleccionar
    Elijo vivir contento.
    I choose to be happy.
  2. to elect
    Synonyms: (obsolete) esleír, (obsolete) eligir
